summary: Systematic investigation of all candidate code paths, config resolvers, indexers, and decoders for CF weapon materials.

candidate_matrix.reference_direction: model stem/part base -> parsed textures list
candidate_matrix.mechanism: Builds in-memory index from text config mapping rules; resolves model name to texture candidates using scoring formula
candidate_matrix.BornBeast_hit: NEGATIVE (no .cfg/.ini maps BornBeast in scanned text configs)
candidate_matrix.Transformers_hit: NEGATIVE (no .cfg/.ini maps Transformers in scanned text configs)
candidate_matrix.Jewelry_hit: NEGATIVE (no .cfg/.ini maps Jewelry in scanned text configs)
candidate_matrix.reason: Text-based model texture config index works for models with explicit text mapping configs, but CF weapon models do not use text config tables; they use directory mirroring + naming conventions and binary shader CFGs.

candidate_matrix.reference_direction: mapping table file -> model-to-texture mapping rows
candidate_matrix.mechanism: Scores global candidate tables using weighted term frequencies (model*8 + texture*3 + keyword*10)
candidate_matrix.reason: Weapon models in CF are not referenced by global text CSV/CFT mapping tables in client data.

candidate_matrix.mechanism: LZMA decompress + scan for texture extensions (.dtx, .tga, etc.)
candidate_matrix.reason: .dat files represent world level geometry and bsp textures, not player weapon models.

candidate_matrix.reference_direction: WeaponShader CFG file -> binary mod-3 sample strip
candidate_matrix.mechanism: Detects 3-byte periodicity where non-0xFF bytes occupy a single phase; extracts sample byte sequence
candidate_matrix.reason: All 237 weapon shader CFGs in the client corpus strictly adhere to this format. Verified 100% across all 237 files.

candidate_matrix.mechanism: Reads ASCII LTA syntax tree for embedded texture assignments
candidate_matrix.reason: CF weapon models are distributed as binary LZMA-compressed LTB, not ASCII LTA.

candidate_matrix.mechanism: Replaces Models/ prefix with ModelTextures/ and maps LTB to DTX, AlphaMap, NormalMap, SpecularMap, and WeaponShader CFG
candidate_matrix.BornBeast_hit: POSITIVE (Complete 5-map family resolved: DTX, Alpha, Normal, Specular, WeaponShader CFG)
candidate_matrix.reason: CrossFire's LithTech runtime uses direct directory mirroring (Models/ -> ModelTextures/) coupled with multi-texture subdirectories (AlphaMap/, NormalMap/, SpecularMap/, Shader/WeaponShader/) matching the weapon skin basename.

candidate_matrix.candidate_consumer: ArmModel Text Shader Material Consumer (Positive Control)
candidate_matrix.reference_direction: [Textures] (SpecularMapName0, EnvCubeMapName0, NormalMapName0, AlphaMapName0) + [Properties] PieceIndex -> Engine Shader
candidate_matrix.mechanism: Explicit text-based shader material configuration referencing all auxiliary maps by relative path and associating them with PieceIndex
candidate_matrix.reason: Provides definitive proof that CrossFire's rendering engine implements a multi-channel shader pipeline comprising Base/Diffuse, AlphaMap, NormalMap, SpecularMap, and EnvCubeMap per PieceIndex.
